diagnosis: The v5 symmetric occurrence design is systematically incompatible with sparse obligate dependents in the audited panel: 0/5 dependent GBIF endpoints passed the frozen occurrence floor.

Replacing dependent GBIF occurrences with primary-literature witnesses solved the dependent-side gate for KIM001 but did not solve arbitrary-host occurrence feasibility: KIM001 failed the unchanged focal-host 50/30/10 floor.

Across all six sampling endpoints, focal host X failed the frozen host floor in 4/6 cases. Pair-first biological admission therefore remains a major feasibility bottleneck even after the v7 witness-source change.
No negative-control or invariant result has been opened, so these findings diagnose the evidence interface rather than the ecological invariant.
design_implication: Do not lower floors or rescue opened pairs. Any successor should prospectively screen NEW engineering candidates for host breadth using independent literature/range evidence before occurrence access, while keeping actual GBIF counts forbidden during candidate selection. A later held-out confirmation pair is required after that prescreen is frozen and debugged.
nonretroactivity: KIM001 remains terminal and cannot be rerun under a new prescreen
sampling floors remain 50 independent records / 30 unique 10-km cells / 10 effective cells for host recovery
literature witness floor remains 5 independent witnesses / 3 unique 10-km cells
an engineering-pilot success after this audit is not a confirmatory invariant result
